welcome.title: Your money, term by term
welcome.body: TermPocket sorts your income and spending into school terms (Winter, Spring and Fall), so every study or co-op term gets its own picture.

add.title: Add what you earn and spend
add.body: Type a transaction in, or import a screenshot from your banking app, a receipt, Uber or WeChat Pay. The image is read on your device and never uploaded.

pocky.title: Ask Pocky
pocky.body: Tell Pocky what you spent and it drafts the entries. Nothing is saved until you confirm. You can also ask about your spending, or plan toward a goal.

goals.title: Save toward a goal
goals.body: Set a target and a date. When last month left money over, TermPocket suggests adding some of it to your goal.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: Start with one transaction, or let Pocky do the typing.
done.bodyNoPocky: Start with your first transaction. Your dashboard fills in as you go.

card.title: Getting started
card.body: A one-minute tour of how TermPocket works.

termsGateIntro: Before you go on, please read and accept the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>. In short:
termsGatePoint1: Your records are stored to run TermPocket, and you can delete them, or your whole account, at any time.
termsGatePoint2: If you use Pocky, your messages and the relevant records are sent to an AI provider, which may process them outside Canada.
termsGatePoint3: TermPocket helps you track money; nothing in it is financial advice.

A study term spends and a co-op term ear: A study term spends and a co-op term earns. TermPocket helps university and college students in Canada follow their money the way they live it: one four-month term at a time, through study terms, co-op placements, internships and summer breaks.
See income, spending and savings for thi: See income, spending and savings for this term, last term or the whole year, so a co-op term and a study term are easy to compare.

deleteAccount.deleteSummary: Permanently delete your account and everything in it. You will be signed out and cannot sign in again with this account.
deleteAccount.body: This permanently deletes your account and cannot be undone. Deleted:
deleteAccount.item1: your profile: name, email address, password, language and email preferences, and the automatic deletion setting;
deleteAccount.item2: all of your transactions and savings goals;
deleteAccount.item3: all of your Pocky conversations, with their messages, drafts, goal proposals, undo receipts and usage records;
deleteAccount.item4: your AI connection tokens, which stop working at once, and your screenshot import counts.
deleteAccount.note: Copies already sent to service providers (for example, Pocky messages sent to the model provider) are not deleted by this. You can register again later with the same address, as a new, empty account.
deleteAccount.demoRefused: The demo account is shared and cannot be deleted.

mcpGuide.codexCheck: Start Codex in the same terminal and use /mcp to check the connection. No OAuth login needed.
mcpGuide.codexApp: For the app or IDE, make TERMPOCKET_TOKEN available to its process, then restart it.
mcpGuide.claudeDetails: Expand Connection details below. Use the endpoint as the connector URL and the request header with your token.
mcpGuide.otherDetails: In an app that supports remote MCP over HTTP with custom headers, add the endpoint and request header from Connection details below. Replace <token> with your token.
